# `prefer-anonymous-initializer`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports a named aggregate initializer that repeats a type already established by
the result location.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`.{ ... }` avoids duplicating the type and remains correct when the binding's
type spelling changes.

## When it fires

It applies when the result type is explicit and identical to the initializer
type.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const Point = struct { x: i32, y: i32 };

const origin: Point = Point{ .x = 0, .y = 0 };
```
